headline: Lufthansa Acquires Stake in TAP Air Portugal for R$7.3 Billion
summary: Lufthansa announced the acquisition of up to 49.9% of Portuguese carrier TAP Air Portugal in a deal valued at R$7.3 billion, aiming to expand flight connections between Brazil and Europe.
why: Airline consolidations and cross-border equity stakes allow carriers to optimize route networks, share operational efficiencies, and enhance international connectivity.

impacts.name: Lufthansa
impacts.why: Acquiring a major stake in TAP Air Portugal involves significant capital outlay while expanding network integration.
